name: Large single transfer
rationale: Precision equals the base rate and 1 unique laundering account; R12 covers large flows relative to the profile

name: Structuring below 10k
rationale: Convert amounts to USD before the 8,000-9,999.99 band, as documented

name: Fan-out
rationale: Below-the-line test: 10 distinct beneficiaries finds laundering accounts at 15x the base rate

name: Activity spike
rationale: Known-payroll exclusion for customers whose KYC declares salary batches

name: Fan-in
rationale: Below-the-line test: 10 distinct remitters doubles the laundering accounts found, precision stays ~7%

name: Round amounts
rationale: Largest rule in a normal week at the system's average precision; raise the floor, recover misses with the score

name: High-risk customer outflow
rationale: Above-the-line test: -22% volume for 1 unique laundering account
